prod.emptyBody: Add your first product to start buying and selling.
prod.baseUnitHint: The smallest unit you sell, e.g. pcs, kg.
prod.minPriceHint: Selling below this needs approval when the rule is on.
prod.packHelp: A box is a bigger unit, e.g. 1 box = 24 {unit}. Give it its own prices or leave them empty to use the piece price times the box size.
prod.packInvalid: Each pack needs a name and at least 2 units.
prod.reorderHint: You are warned when stock falls to this level (in {unit}).
prod.barcodesHint: One per line. Scan or type.
prod.trackExpiryHint: Each purchase records a batch and expiry; sales use the earliest expiry first.
prod.trackExpiryLocked: Cannot change after the product has stock history.
prod.archiveBody: Archived products are hidden from selling but keep their history.
sup.emptyBody: Add the companies you buy from.
sup.openingHint: Amount you already owe this supplier today.
ledger.title: Ledger
pur.emptyBody: Record goods you buy to add them to stock.
pur.noLinesBody: Search above and press Enter to add an item.
pur.cashMustPay: A purchase without a supplier must be paid in full.
pur.voidHelp: Stock and the supplier balance are restored. The record stays visible as cancelled.
pur.returnHelp: Enter the quantity you are sending back. The credit defaults to the original price.
inv.noBatchesBody: Turn on expiry tracking on a product, then buy it.
inv.totalValueHint: Leave empty to use the average cost.
prod.dealerHint: Leave empty to use the wholesale price.
pur.dupWarn: This company invoice number was already entered on {doc}. Check it is not the same invoice twice.
pur.noLinked: This company has no products yet
pur.noLinkedBody: Use Add many products, Paste from Excel or the search box. Products you buy are linked to the company automatically.
pur.rowProblems: {n} rows need a cost or an expiry date before saving.
pur.discountTooBig: The discount is more than the bill.
pur.moreMatches: Showing {shown} of {total}. Type more to narrow the list.
pur.pasteHelp: Copy the rows from Excel (or a CSV) and paste them here. Choose which column is the product, box, pieces and cost. Rows that do not match are shown so you can fix or skip them.
pur.pasteProblem.badBox: Box is not a whole number
pur.pasteProblem.badPcs: Pcs is not a whole number
pur.pricesHelp: The cost is what one box cost on this invoice, with discount, VAT and freight. Change a price and its row is ticked; only ticked rows are saved.
pur.alsoPiecePrice: Also set the piece price (box price divided by pieces per box)
pur.returnTooMuch: You are returning more than this purchase brought in.
sup.noLinksBody: Link the products this company sells. They then appear ready to fill in when you enter its invoice.
prod.defaultSaleHint: The unit a new line starts in at the counter.
prod.defaultPurchaseHint: The unit a company invoice line starts in.
prod.bulk.archiveBody: These products will be hidden from selling but keep their history. Their SKU and barcodes stay reserved. You can restore them any time.
prod.bulk.restoreBody: These products will show up in selling again.
prod.bulk.canDelete: {n} can be deleted. Nothing refers to them, so they will be removed for good and their SKU and barcodes become free again.
prod.bulk.cannotDelete: {n} cannot be deleted and will be archived instead. Products with history are kept so old invoices, stock and reports stay correct. They have:
prod.bulk.why.hasStock: {n} with stock or stock history, including opening stock
prod.bulk.why.hasHistory: {n} with other history, such as stock adjustments
prod.bulk.nothingToDelete: None of the selected products can be deleted. All of them will be archived instead.
prod.bulk.doneArchiveSkip: {changed} archived, {skipped} skipped because they were already archived or no longer exist.
prod.bulk.doneRestoreSkip: {changed} restored, {skipped} skipped because they were already active or no longer exist.
prod.bulk.doneDeleteMixed: {deleted} deleted, {archived} archived instead because they have sales or stock history.
prod.bulk.doneDeleteNone: Nothing was deleted. {archived} archived instead because they have sales or stock history.
prod.bulk.tooMany: Up to {max} products can be changed at a time. Select fewer products, for example by filtering the list first.
prod.soldByBoxHint: Turn on if this product comes in boxes or cartons. Stock is always counted in {unit}.
prod.pcsPerBoxErr: Enter how many {unit} are in 1 box (at least 2).
prod.morePacks: More packs: dozen, carton, dealer price, box barcode
pur.setBoxHelp: The box is saved on the product, so sales, stock and the next purchase use it too. Stock stays counted in pieces.
